subject: FintechCo post-demo: performance SLO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Zhang <alice@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: performance SLO checklist & next steps

Hi Alice / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today. As promised, here’s a concise recap of the performance SLOs we discussed and proposed next steps so we have a single place to align. I’ve attached a short SLO checklist (post-demo-slo-checklist.xlsx).

Performance SLO summary (from today)
- Latency target: P95 <= 200ms for single-turn completion (streaming preferred for token-level updates)
- Throughput: target steady-state 100 req/s for peak flows (burst to 150 req/s)
- Concurrency: ~30 concurrent sessions with KV-cache warm for chat workloads
- Streaming: required for progressive UX (server push + chunked responses)
- SLA: availability target 99.9% for production endpoints

Open questions for your team:
1) Do you have a firm P95/P99 target for both short-response (single prompt) and long-response (multi-turn) paths?
2) Any hard constraints on cold-start latencies or max allowed tail latencies?
3) Can you share a representative request distribution or a small sample of traffic patterns (size, tokens per request, frequency)?

Next steps (proposed)
- We’ll schedule a targeted perf run with our SE kit against a sanitized staging snapshot (2 weeks) — action: Redwood SE (Monica)
- We’ll validate streaming behavior and SDK integration in a short PoC and capture token-level latency traces — action: Redwood AE (Aditya)
- We’ll produce a short decision criteria doc tying perf numbers to cost estimates and model/quantization recommendations — action: Marissa

Can you confirm the above targets and share any additional constraints by EOD Wednesday? Once confirmed we’ll lock the MAP and schedule the perf window.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: post-demo-slo-checklist.xlsx
From: Alice Zhang <alice@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-07-06T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: performance SLO checklist & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Great recap, thanks. A few clarifications and the targets we wanted to confirm from our side:

Confirmed targets
- P95 latency: 150ms for short responses (~<100 tokens), P99 <= 350ms
- Long responses (300-800 tokens): P95 <= 650ms (we understand streaming will change measured metrics)
- Sustained throughput: 120 req/s with bursts to 250 req/s during peak minute windows
- Concurrency: expect up to 40 concurrent active chat sessions during peak trading hours
- Streaming: required (we rely on partial results for UX)

Notes / constraints
- Cold-starts: we prefer cold-start <= 800ms for resumed sessions; warm paths are higher priority
- Tokenization differences: our frontend uses a lower-fragment tokenizer and average token-per-request is ~120 for short, ~420 for long
- Security: we’ll need a short SOC2 / infra diagram for the perf PoC environment (we can accept a redacted network diagram)

I’ve attached our internal target summary (fintechco-targets.pdf) — feel free to use for the MAP. We’re comfortable with the proposed 2-week perf window as long as we can run tests in a staging VPC that mirrors our expected concurrency.

Thanks,
Alice Zhang
Head of Engineering, FintechCo
alice@fintechco.com

- Perf window: propose July 19–23 as the perf run week (2x 4-hour windows to validate steady-state and burst) — owner: Monica
- Test environment: Redwood will provision a staging VPC with a mirrored concurrency profile; will share redacted infra diagram for SOC2 questions — owner: Aditya
- Streaming validation: we’ll capture token-level traces and SDK latency (chunk times) and provide examples of progressive rendering — owner: Marissa
- Decision criteria doc: will map P95/P99 numbers to cost and recommend quantization/model variant options for your workload — owner: Marissa (deliverable by July 16)

Can we confirm: staging VPC + redacted infra diagram by July 9, decision criteria doc by July 16, perf run week July 19–23? If that timeline works I’ll send calendar invites and a short prep checklist for the perf windows.

Attachments: internal-slo-draft.pdf

Best,
Marissa
